[[Category:Vector space basis]]
A '''basis (plural: bases)''' of a vector space is any of its '''linearly independent''' [[vector space generating set]]. i.e.,

{{#content:Q2144}}

<blockquote>
Intuition: each linearly independent $u_k, k \in \{1,\cdots,n\}$ introduces one independent dimension, for a total of $n$ dimensions in the vector space.
</blockquote>

== Change of basis ==

See [[transition matrix between bases of a vector space]].
